column3: Saori Route ・ Penetrated into the Heart
*sigh*...
Saori looks like she's at her limit...
Should I say something clever?
Hey, Saori...
Kyousuke-shi... sorry...
Could you listen to what I have to say?
Ah, sure...
Saori is the one saying this now. Guess I should lend an ear.
Don't push yourself, Saori.
Kyousuke-shi?
It's also painful for me, seeing you like this.
...Fufu. As expected, you are always so kind.
But, could you listen to me now?
Ah, yeah.
One week ago, when we met at Akihabara, you said this to me.
You said, "Whatever happens, our friendship will hold strong..."
Your sincerity has reached deep into my internal organs.
What's with this, all of a sudden...
Being the kind person that you are, even if I said we were no longer friends, you'd probably still think of me as one.
Those feelings from you are enough.
Saori...
I'm truly sorry that I could not accept the souvenir from your school trip!
Please take good care of it along with all the other goods I gave you.
Saori... Does she really want to dispose of her goods?
But if I'm not mistaken, Saori's otaku goods...
Hey, those otaku goods aren't just yours, right?
Yes... among them were things from my older sister and her friends.
Even for him, I don't think he would want to throw away other people's things, but...
If it is okay with you, I would like you hold on to those...
...If it's on a temporary basis, sure. But I can't keep them forever.
That answer is enough.
...Thank you for all you've done.
The days I have spent with everyone are treasures I will cherish my entire life. Even when I lose my goods, I will still have that.
And so...
...Goodbye.
I was left behind, looking at the back of the figure of Saori getting smaller and smaller.
I have said what I could.
Even words used by great people throughout history won't reach her now.
She was so determined. She was serious enough to make anyone think that.
But...
I can't just accept this, right?
Saying "Okay goodbye," just after failing three times, I can't accept this lousy scenario!
Saori!!
